skill.name: busco-phylogeny
skill.description: Generate phylogenomics workflows from genome assemblies using BUSCO or compleasm single-copy orthologs.
skill.summary: Build scheduler-aware BUSCO/compleasm phylogenomics workflows from genome assemblies.
skill.author: brunoasm

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown examples, expected scientific workflow scripts, or third-party Perl syntax. Confirmed concerns are job templates that source ~/.bashrc and wrapper scripts that construct shell commands for eval from user-influenced values. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, persistence, or malicious exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: Wrapper scripts execute constructed shell command strings with eval.
remediation.suggestion: Replace eval with argv arrays or direct Perl invocation, quote every argument, and validate filenames and option values before execution.

remediation.issue: Scheduler and local templates source ~/.bashrc before activating Conda.
remediation.suggestion: Use explicit Conda initialization, documented module loading, or a user-provided profile path instead of sourcing arbitrary shell startup files by default.

remediation.issue: External tool downloads and bundled third-party scripts lack checksum guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Pin versions, document upstream licenses, and provide checksums or package-manager alternatives for downloaded bioinformatics tools.

content.value_statement: Phylogenomics from genome assemblies requires many tools, scheduler scripts, and quality checks. This skill guides BUSCO or compleasm ortholog extraction, alignment, trimming, tree inference, and methods reporting.
actual_capabilities: Guides mixed local genome and NCBI accession inputs for phylogenomics projects.
Generates SLURM, PBS, and local workflow scripts from bundled templates.
Uses helper scripts for NCBI assembly lookup, genome download, renaming, QC, and ortholog extraction.
Supports compleasm or BUSCO, MAFFT, trimming tools, FASconCAT, IQ-TREE, and ASTRAL workflows.
Creates quality-control guidance and a draft methods paragraph for publication workflows.
limitations: Requires external bioinformatics tools, Conda environments, or scheduler access to run generated scripts.
Generated scripts must be reviewed against the target cluster policies before large runs.
NCBI assembly lookup and downloads require network access and valid accessions.
Users must review taxon sampling, lineage choice, and biological interpretation of final trees.

prompt_templates.prompt: Help me find genome assemblies from NCBI for my focal taxon, choose appropriate accessions, and prepare them for a BUSCO or compleasm phylogeny.

prompt_templates.prompt: Create SLURM or PBS scripts for compleasm, MAFFT alignment, trimming, IQ-TREE, and ASTRAL using my genome count, CPU limits, memory, walltime, and BUSCO lineage.

best_practices: Confirm tool versions, scheduler limits, and Conda activation behavior before running generated scripts.
Use stable sample names that include accession and species information for tree traceability.
Run the first compleasm job separately so the BUSCO lineage database is cached before parallel jobs.
anti_patterns: Submitting all genome jobs before confirming the lineage database and environment setup.
Using vague sample names that make final tree labels difficult to trace.
Skipping QC interpretation and methods documentation after tree generation.

faq.question: Does this skill run phylogenomic tools automatically?
faq.answer: It mainly generates and validates workflow scripts. Users run those scripts in their own local, SLURM, or PBS environment.

faq.question: Can it use NCBI genomes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance and helper scripts for finding assemblies, downloading genomes, and renaming files for tree labels.

faq.question: Which ortholog tools does it support?
faq.answer: It focuses on BUSCO or compleasm single-copy orthologs and then connects those outputs to alignment and tree-building steps.

faq.question: Can it make cluster job scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes templates for SLURM, PBS, and local execution, with placeholders for CPUs, memory, walltime, lineage, and locus counts.

faq.question: Does it choose the best substitution model?
faq.answer: It recommends model sets and uses IQ-TREE model selection, but users should confirm choices for their taxon and sequence type.

faq.question: What should users review before running scripts?
faq.answer: Users should check paths, scheduler account settings, Conda activation, CPU and memory requests, tool versions, and all downloaded dependencies.
